name: Dermatologist

pf.license.need: always: each dermatologist (MD or DO), physician assistant and nurse practitioner who sees patients holds their own active license from the state where the patient is during the visit, video included
pf.license.who: each person; the practice too where the state's form registers medical offices or a place of care away from the office
pf.license.ask: each clinician's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the practice's registration, and any permit for care away from the office, from the owner
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.video: a video visit only with a clinician licensed in the state where the patient is that day; the patient says the state before any times
pf.license.cosmetic: who may give cosmetic injections (Botox, filler), and under whose supervision: each state's own rule, from the state form (a switch); only the injectors the practice lists are offered
pf.license.away: skin checks at the patient's home or care home (a workplace or a care home) only where the state's rules allow care away from the office, with any permit the state's form asks for (a switch)
pf.license.agreement: a health privacy agreement (a HIPAA business associate agreement) signed on the secure page before the first booking; every company in Rosie's chain signs one with Rosie
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: malpractice insurance where the state's form or a care home asks for it

pf.services.shape: visit types with set lengths, each with a clinician by name; medical visits are billed to the patient's health plan or paid by the patient; cosmetic visits are paid by the patient; anything added at the visit, like a biopsy, needs the patient's yes first
pf.services.examples: the example offices' own prices (Lee Dermatology and Lee Mobile Derm), not a standard; a plan pays its own fee, and the patient's share is an estimate

pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the patient is always there

stop.words: swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat, or trouble breathing (for example after a new medicine or a shot)
stop.say: This needs care now. Call 911. Don't wait for a skin visit.

stop.words: a fast-spreading rash with blisters, peeling skin or a high fever
stop.say: Please call 911 or go to the emergency room now.

stop.words: bleeding that won't stop after 20 minutes of firm pressure
stop.say: Call 911 or go to the emergency room now.

stop.words: swallowed a skin medicine, or too much of one
stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222, or 911 if they're not awake or not breathing.

goOn.words: a spot or wound that's red, hot and spreading, a rash near the eye, or a cosmetic area that turns white or very painful after filler
goOn.what: the safety steps first: go to urgent care today, or call the office's own line; the booking can go on after

goOn.words: a spot that changed, a rash, acne or itching with nothing else
goOn.what: matched to the office's own visit types; Rosie never says what a spot might be or how soon to be seen

pf.safety.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history, medicines, consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit; one reminder before it's due
steps.who: every new patient; returning patients once a year, or when their health changes
steps.result: not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand; when the desk is closed, by the next business day
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (checked later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A referral from the primary care doctor

steps.who: the patient asks that doctor's office; Rosie never contacts it; the desk marks it in
steps.goodFor: the visits and the end date the referral itself sets
steps.result: not in 2 business days before the visit: the patient picks on the secure page (ask the doctor again, pay for the visit, or a call from the desk); the text never says 'referral'

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay and cosmetic patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day (the example office's rule), or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: A cosmetic consult before a first filler
steps.result: the injector OKs it, suggests another plan, or calls it off with a full refund

pf.first_steps.prep: new patients arrive 15 minutes early; bring a photo ID and the plan card; for a skin check, come without nail polish or makeup so the whole skin can be checked; the office's own notes for the visit are on the secure page

pf.visit.checkIn: at the office: the check-in code at the front desk; by video: the code read out at the start; at a home visit: the code at the exam room's door
pf.visit.beforeWork: the clinician reads the health history and any photos the patient added, and checks for changes
pf.visit.changes: a biopsy, or freezing a spot, is added only with the patient's yes after the clinician explains it; its self-pay price comes from the list, or the plan is billed; cosmetic units are agreed before any shot
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the clinician's notes, skin photos taken at the visit and results stay in the office's own medical record, never in a text
pf.visit.results: a biopsy result comes from the office in about 7 to 10 days, by phone or on the office's secure page; Rosie's text only says the office will call, never what the result is
pf.visit.away: at the patient's home or care home: a private room with a door, set up by the clinician; anything to look at more closely is booked at the office

pf.money.before: medical visits: nothing taken at booking (the office bills health plans); a card saved only where the office turns on its missed-visit fee; cosmetic visits: a $40 deposit, counted toward the visit; at a home visit: nothing taken
pf.money.plans: the plans the office takes, and which need a referral (set at sign-up); the front desk checks each plan by hand and records it: covered or not, and the patient's share; the share is an estimate, not a promise
pf.money.selfPay: a self-pay or cosmetic patient is told while booking that they can get a written price estimate, and gets it on time; the lab that reads a biopsy bills on its own
pf.money.fees: the missed-visit or late-cancel fee: $20 at the example office, only when the owner confirms it; the same fee for every patient who may be charged one; a cosmetic visit's fee is its $40 deposit
pf.money.feeFree: a switch: no fee ever for patients whose plan or the state's rules bar one (like Medicaid, where that applies), or whom the owner marks fee-free; their texts say 'No fee to cancel or miss'
pf.money.after: claims sent by the office; the patient pays the share at the front desk, its own way; a balance after the plan pays is billed by the office, not by Rosie's text; at the patient's home or care home, the office bills the plan (or the host, where it pays for the day) its own way
pf.money.rosfield: the $2 per booking applies to this work, as to every kind of work (D97): a flat fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes, shown at sign-up for the owner's yes; a booking the business puts in itself carries no $2; card payments cost only Stripe's own card fee, paid to Stripe
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form; fee limits for plan patients: from the plan's and the state's rules
pf.money.tax: a tax line on cosmetic visits only where the state taxes them (a switch from the state form)

pf.messages.never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, a referral, the reason, a spot, photos or results; flow A's texts drop the clinician's name; at the patient's home or care home the clinician's name stays, for the door check
pf.messages.results: results come only from the office, by phone or on the secure page; Rosie's text says only that the office will call
pf.messages.channels: health texts by plain SMS and email (Rosie's rule); a patient who says texts aren't safe is reached only the way they pick
pf.messages.staff: texts to the owner and staff use the patient's initials only, with no health detail
pf.messages.minors: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian

pf.staff.licenses: each dermatologist's, physician assistant's and nurse practitioner's own license, per state
pf.staff.skills: dermatologists: every visit, biopsies, cosmetic injections; physician assistants and nurse practitioners: skin checks, problem visits, biopsies, and cosmetic injections where the state allows and the practice lists them; medical assistants and the front desk: no clinical OKs
pf.staff.supervision: a physician assistant works with a supervising or collaborating physician as each state sets (a switch: the supervisor must be working, or reachable); a nurse practitioner works alone or with a physician, as the state sets
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs fees and same-day times; every price is on the list, so no quote waits for him
pf.staff.standIn: a physician assistant may stand in for a skin check or a problem visit, only with the patient's yes, while a supervisor who may supervise them is working (or reachable, where the state's switch allows); with no yes, nobody is moved: the time stays, and the desk calls; cosmetic visits only with another listed injector
pf.staff.away: at the patient's home or care home: only clinicians cleared for care away from the office, each licensed in that state

pf.rules.records: medical records are kept by the office for as long as the state's rules require (a child's records may be kept longer); a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details, never the office's records
pf.rules.copies: a patient's copy of their records within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records
pf.rules.language: free language help where the rules require it (practices that take Medicare or Medicaid); the secure page asks about an interpreter and passes it to the office
pf.rules.consent: a signed consent before a biopsy or a cosmetic treatment; a parent's or guardian's for a minor
pf.rules.estimate: the written price estimate for self-pay patients, where the rules require it
pf.rules.telehealth: a video visit follows the rules of the state the patient is in
pf.rules.host: home and care home visits only where the state's rules allow care away from the office; a care home's own sign-in rules are followed
pf.rules.ads: no claims about results or prices the state's rules don't allow
pf.rules.privacy: health privacy rules for every message and form

pf.edges.lateArrival: up to 15 minutes late: still seen, in the time left; later: the office may offer a new time (the office decides; Rosie never changes the booking itself)
pf.edges.standIn: a clinician out: a physician assistant who may do that visit, while a supervisor is working, or new times with no fee
pf.edges.referral: a referral not in 2 business days before: the patient picks on the secure page; no answer by the day before: the desk calls
pf.edges.forms: a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page before any work), moves it, or cancels with no fee
pf.edges.planChange: the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay at the list price, or a free cancel
pf.edges.results: a result not ready by the date given: staff text LATE before it passes, and the patient hears the new date
pf.edges.spotQuestion: a patient texts about a spot or a result: pointed to the office's own line, and nothing is saved or passed on; danger words get the safety message first
pf.edges.sooner: the list for a sooner time: each opening is offered in order, 30 minutes each
pf.edges.reaction: a reaction after a cosmetic treatment: the safety words first, then the office's own line
pf.edges.feeFree: a fee-free patient is never asked for a card or a fee
pf.edges.minors: a minor books only through a parent or guardian, who comes to the visit
pf.edges.twoBookings: a patient with two open bookings: Rosie asks which one before any change
pf.edges.video: the patient is out of state that day: a visit at the office, or a video time on a day they're back
